exposure: transvaginal removal and repair (TRR) of uterine defect
Transvaginal removal and repair (TRR) of uterine defect
cohort: 87 patients diagnosed with type II cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP II)
finding: TRR was found to be a safe and effective treatment for CSP II, with lower complication rates and costs compared to UAE, and a high proportion of patients achieving full-term delivery without uterine rupture.
